install.description: Builds a SwiftPM executable product in release and renames it over the copy SwiftPM's install folder holds, or installs it through experimental-install when the folder holds none

package.description: Archives each app with its xcodebuild invocation and builds each SwiftPM executable product in release, then zips each under its bundle or product name with ditto; where ASC_API_KEY_P8, ASC_API_KEY_ID, and ASC_API_ISSUER_ID are set, exports each archive under the Developer ID Application identity into a disk image in place of the zip, signs it, notarizes it with that App Store Connect key, and staples the ticket

run.description: Runs swift and xcodebuild invocations in order with Nx's per-task environment removed, stopping at the first failure

release-publish.description: Signs a Sparkle feed for each disk image an export folder holds with generate_appcast under SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY, pointing at the image's asset on the GitHub release nx release tags the archived app's version with, and uploads it to the R2 bucket SPARKLE_FEED_BUCKET names at the path of the app's SUFeedURL through cf r2 objects put; runs through nx release publish
